title: Traffic Violation Detection & SmartCity Platform
summary: A production traffic and camera-data platform combining automated violation detection, high-frequency camera event processing, a React operations dashboard and automated challan generation.
challenge: The enforcement workflow depended heavily on manual review of camera footage. As traffic and camera volume increased, routine review created a growing processing burden and delayed enforcement.
solution: Built a command-line automation tool to detect traffic violations from live camera feeds in real time.
Designed the Laravel backend to ingest, process and store high-frequency camera event data.
Built a responsive React dashboard for monitoring, filtering, replaying and exporting activity.
Automated challan generation and connected tickets to detected violations.
Refactored Eloquent queries and added database indexing for higher-throughput workloads.
Deployed the full-stack system on AWS with reliability and scale in mind.
outcomes: More than 70% reduction in manual processing time.
35% improvement in data-pipeline throughput after ORM refactoring and query indexing.
High-concurrency camera feeds supported with no reported downtime.
